0022600196.text: The Chicago Bulls, 1-7 and on a six-game losing streak, host the Philadelphia 76ers, who are 8-2 and first in the East and the Atlantic Division. Chicago is sitting 5 games back in the Central Division and 14th in the East, and it is without Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation; 19.3 points and 28.8 minutes per game this season) and Zach Collins (illness; 1.5 points and 8.7 minutes per game). Philadelphia is missing Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture), and the Bulls trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 126-107 loss in Philadelphia on November 2, although they won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
